handoff_payload.answer_text: Gross margin is not a meaningful metric for American Express in FY2022 because it is a financial-services company, where interest income, interest expense, and credit-loss provisions—not traditional cost of goods sold—drive profitability. Instead, total revenues net of interest expense increased 24.7% to USD 52,862 million, while provisions for credit losses rose by USD 3,601 million to USD 2,182 million, reducing the after-provisions operating margin from 24.4% to 18.9%.
